environment.description: Actix-web service deployed on a bare EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2023, t3.medium) behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer) with no request inspection. Service listens on port 8080, NLB forwards TCP traffic directly. No API gateway, no WAF, no schema validation. IAM role attached has no relevance to HTTP traffic filtering. Security group allows inbound 443/8080 from 0.0.0.0/0.

config.load_balancer: AWS NLB (TCP passthrough, no TLS termination at LB)
config.runtime: systemd unit, no request filtering proxy
